cases.title: Synthetic end-to-end packaging evidence flow
cases.purpose: Demonstrate traceable evidence from project governance through supplier qualification without making release, sourcing or commercial decisions.
expected_outcomes: drawing and preview evidence remains governed
trial planning and execution evidence resolves
acceptance_checks: all approval decisions remain attributable to named humans

cases.title: Anonymized packaging change-control regression case
cases.purpose: Exercise specification change, implementation authorization, defect evidence and qualification review with anonymized identifiers.
expected_outcomes: implementation authorization requires an approved change
linked evidence cannot cross project boundaries
qualification scope and validity remain explicit
acceptance_checks: repository and database mutations are rejected

cases.title: Controlled-real release-QA evidence reconciliation
cases.purpose: Reconcile exact commit, workflow, job, test and artifact evidence without authorizing tagging, publication or deployment.
expected_outcomes: limitations and unresolved blockers remain visible
readiness remains a human recommendation only
acceptance_checks: test failures and errors must be zero for a ready recommendation
